intent.summary: Ship Rubrix v1.3.0 PR #3 (RUB-29) — PreToolUse invisible cascade redirect + cost-ceiling auto-deny + SubagentStop stage validation + report consensus column + dogfood Passed
intent.details: Final PR of three for v1.3.0 Multi-Evaluator Cascade. Adds three hook responsibilities to cli/src/hooks/handlers.ts: (1) PreToolUse intercepts direct Task calls to output-judge / semantic-judge and invisibly redirects them to the cascade adapter (no main-agent warning, context isolation preserved); (2) handleSubagentStop enforces stage-specific output schema (Stage 2 self_reported_confidence missing → block + re-prompt); (3) cost-ceiling auto-deny when cascade.ts emits over-budget signal during a Stage 3 invocation. hooks/hooks.json adds SubagentStop matchers for semantic-judge / consensus-panel. cli/src/commands/report.ts populates the consensus column with actual stage_history data via --explain <criterion-id>. Finally, root rubrix.json walks brief → rubric → matrix → plan → implement → score at version=1.3.0 with full evaluation_policy provenance (source, locked_at, approved_by, derived_from_brief_hash, frontier_models, max_stage3_criteria, max_frontier_votes, estimated_cost_ceiling) and reaches state=Passed under the new cascade orchestrator.

criteria.description: cli/src/hooks/handlers.ts:handlePreToolUse intercepts Task calls whose subagent_type matches output-judge or semantic-judge and whose origin is not the cascade orchestrator, returning hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision='deny' with a redirect-to-cascade reason; cascade-internal calls (originating from cli/src/core/cascade.ts) bypass this gate; non-Task tools are unaffected; redirect text never surfaces in additionalContext, hookSpecificOutput.message, or any main-agent transcript channel.

cli/src/hooks/handlers.ts:handleSubagentStop validates SubagentStop event payloads where subagent_type=semantic-judge requires tool_response.self_reported_confidence as a number in [0,1], and subagent_type=consensus-panel requires exactly the keys {score, rationale_hash, dissent_flag}; missing or malformed fields exit 2 with stderr 'Stage N output schema violation: <field>; re-run agent with the field populated'; valid payloads exit 0 and emit no stderr.

When cli/src/core/cascade.ts BudgetState detects spent_cost > evaluation_policy.estimated_cost_ceiling, the orchestrator emits a budget-exceeded marker that handlePreToolUse reads on the next Stage 3 invocation (subagent_type=consensus-panel or any cascade-tagged Task) and rejects with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision='deny' + reason 'evaluation_policy.estimated_cost_ceiling exceeded; re-lock policy via rubrix lock --force <reason> or pass --approve-expensive to score'; subsequent Stage 1 and Stage 2 calls remain allowed.

Pre-v1.3 contracts (version=0.x or 1.0.x or 1.1.x or 1.2.x) carrying scores[].evaluator='output-judge' as a string (legacy single-evaluator form) pass schema validation, render correctly via rubrix report (no consensus column row), and survive rubrix score with cli-default policy fallback when no evaluation_policy is present; examples/self-eval and examples/ios-refactor remain valid; no fail-closed regressions on legacy contracts.

agents/output-judge.md frontmatter gains deprecated_in: 1.3.0 marker but agent body content remains untouched; cli/src/hooks/handlers.ts injects no deprecation, redirect, or downgrade text into PreToolUse hookSpecificOutput.message, PostToolUse additionalContext, UserPromptExpansion expansionText, or Stop output; main-agent transcript stays free of any string containing 'output-judge' that originates from rubrix hooks.

cli/src/commands/report.ts default rendering (no flags) on a v1.3 contract shows the consensus column with marker text 'stage1', 'stage2', 'stage3', or 'skipped_due_to_budget' per criterion (sourced from scores[].stage_history last entry stage), without leaking individual model_version, prompt_version, score, self_reported_confidence, or rationale_hash; --explain <criterion-id> flag adds a dedicated section to stdout listing every stage_history entry's full schema for that single criterion only.

Root rubrix.json evaluation_policy carries source as one of {brief, user, cli-default}, locked_at as ISO 8601 timestamp ending with Z or numeric offset, approved_by as non-empty string, derived_from_brief_hash as 64-hex matching /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, stage1_required as boolean, stage3_threshold as number in 0..1, stage3_axes as array drawn from {security,data,correctness,ux,perf}, max_stage3_criteria ≥1, max_frontier_votes ≥1, estimated_cost_ceiling >0, frontier_models as non-empty array of strings; rubrix validate enforces these via the v1.3+ schema branch.

Root rubrix.json walks IntentDrafted then RubricLocked then MatrixLocked then PlanLocked then Scoring then Passed under the v1.3.0 schema branch, with all clarity gates (rubric, matrix, plan score ≥ effective threshold given axis_depth.security=deep + correctness=deep), brief gate, and evaluation_policy require all enforced inline; final state field equals 'Passed' and locks.rubric, locks.matrix, locks.plan all true; rubrix gate exits 0 with total ≥ rubric.threshold.

Root rubrix.json containing version=1.3.0 + .clarity entries on rubric/matrix/plan + evaluators[] + stage_history[] + evaluation_policy validates clean against the worktree CLI; the same contract validates clean against an installed plugin v1.2.1 CLI by exercising the v1.2 fail-open branch (which accepts v1.3 fields silently); the v1.2 dogfood incident is therefore not reintroduced when users install v1.3.0 over an existing v1.2 plugin.

hooks/hooks.json SubagentStop array gains entries whose matcher.subagent_type values are 'semantic-judge' and 'consensus-panel'; existing matchers (brief-interviewer and others) are preserved untouched; each new entry's command is the canonical '$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/cli/bin/rubrix.js hook subagent-stop' invocation string; claude plugin validate . exits 0 against the new hooks.json with no schema warnings.

cd cli && npm test reports zero failed and zero skipped tests; baseline 426 (post PR #1+#2 merge) is preserved; RUB-29 adds at minimum 5 new integration test files (pretooluse-direct-call-redirect, subagent-stop-stage-validation, output-judge-historical-read, cost-ceiling-hook-deny, output-judge-invisible-redirect) totalling at least 20 new test cases across the v1.3 hook surface area.

cd cli && npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exits 0 with zero type errors after the v1.3.0 PR #3 changes are applied; cli/src/hooks/handlers.ts plus the cascade signal interface plus integration test files all conform to the strict tsconfig configured for the package; no type-only test casts violate noUncheckedIndexedAccess or noImplicitAny.

rows.evidence_required: vitest pretooluse-direct-call-redirect.test.ts asserts 4 fixture cases: (1) handlePreToolUse({tool_name:'Task', tool_input:{subagent_type:'semantic-judge'}}) from main-agent origin returns hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision='deny'; (2) same call but tool_input adds {_cascade_origin:'rubrix-cascade-orchestrator'} returns permissionDecision='allow'; (3) subagent_type='output-judge' from main-agent returns permissionDecision='deny'; (4) tool_name='Edit' file_path='foo.ts' returns no decision (passthrough). Each block adds expect(result.hookSpecificOutput?.message ?? '').not.toMatch(/output-judge/) and expect(result.additionalContext).toBeUndefined() to confirm zero leakage of redirect text.

vitest subagent-stop-stage-validation.test.ts asserts: (a) SubagentStop with subagent_type='semantic-judge' and tool_response={score:0.5,rationale:'x'} missing self_reported_confidence → handleSubagentStop exit 2 + stderr matches /self_reported_confidence/; (b) tool_response adds self_reported_confidence:0.7 → exit 0 silent; (c) subagent_type='consensus-panel' tool_response with extra key beyond {score,rationale_hash,dissent_flag} → exit 2 + stderr matches /unexpected key/; (d) consensus-panel tool_response with exactly the 3 required keys → exit 0 silent.

vitest cost-ceiling-hook-deny.test.ts builds a v1.3 contract with evaluation_policy.estimated_cost_ceiling=0.01 + a persisted budget marker (env RUBRIX_BUDGET_OVERRUN=1 or contract scores[].stage_history with cumulative cost > 0.01); calls handlePreToolUse({tool_name:'Task', tool_input:{subagent_type:'consensus-panel'}}) and expects hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision='deny' with reason matching /estimated_cost_ceiling/ and /rubrix lock --force|--approve-expensive/; same call with subagent_type='mechanical-checker' returns no decision; subagent_type='semantic-judge' under cascade-internal origin returns no decision (Stage 1 + Stage 2 remain allowed regardless of cost ceiling).

vitest output-judge-historical-read.test.ts loads examples/self-eval/rubrix.json (version=0.1.0 with scores[].evaluator='output-judge' string form) and asserts: (1) ajv validate exits with ok=true and zero error entries; (2) reportCommand stdout contains rows for every criterion but the consensus column cell for legacy-evaluator entries is the empty string (no 'output-judge' marker leaked); (3) scoreCommand on the same contract reads evaluation_policy as the cli-default fallback (no evaluation_policy field on disk) and emits stdout matching /^passed=\d+ skipped=\d+ blockers=\d+$/ without throwing on the legacy evaluator string.

vitest output-judge-invisible-redirect.test.ts asserts: (a) reading agents/output-judge.md, the YAML frontmatter contains a line matching /^deprecated_in: 1\.3\.0$/m; (b) the body section after the closing --- is byte-equivalent to the SHA-256 captured pre-PR-#3 (snapshot baseline file checked into cli/tests/snapshots/); (c) for every hook event handler (handlePreToolUse, handlePostToolUse, handleUserPromptExpansion, handleStop, handleSubagentStop) called with a representative input set, the returned object has no field whose JSON.stringify(value) contains the substring 'output-judge'.

vitest report-consensus.test.ts builds a v1.3 contract with scores[]=[{criterion:'a', stage_history:[{stage:1,...},{stage:2,model_version:'sonnet-4-6@2026-04-01',score:0.7,self_reported_confidence:0.65}]}]; calls reportCommand({path:'tmp.json'}) (no flags) and asserts stdout contains a table row 'a | ... | stage2 | ...' AND stdout does NOT contain the substrings 'sonnet-4-6@2026-04-01', 'self_reported_confidence', 'rationale_hash', or 'prompt_version'; calls reportCommand({path:'tmp.json', explain:'a'}) and asserts stdout adds a section starting '## explain: a' listing every stage_history entry's full schema (stage, model, model_version, prompt_version, score, self_reported_confidence).

vitest evaluation-policy-schema.test.ts (extended with provenance suite) asserts ajv-driven invalidation of: (a) evaluation_policy missing source field; (b) source='automation' outside enum; (c) locked_at='2026-05-09' date only without time; (d) approved_by=''; (e) derived_from_brief_hash='ABC' which is 3 chars not 64-hex; (f) stage3_threshold=1.5 above 1.0; (g) max_stage3_criteria=0 below 1; (h) frontier_models=[] empty array. Positive case with all fields well-formed returns ok=true. Direct call to validateContract on root rubrix.json (v1.3.0 with full evaluation_policy) returns ok=true.

Manual lifecycle walk evidence captured as a shell session transcript: rubrix state get rubrix.json prints IntentDrafted; after rubric edit + rubrix lock rubric rubrix.json prints 'rubric locked -> RubricLocked'; analogous for matrix and plan; after a recorded cascade run populates scores[] with stage_history, rubrix state set rubrix.json Scoring + rubrix gate rubrix.json --apply transitions through Scoring to Passed; final state get prints Passed; rubrix gate rubrix.json exits 0 with stdout starting 'PASS total=' and a numeric total ≥ 0.8.
